subject: Payments Feature — Sprint Kickoff
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the Payments feature sprint. Per the Q4 roadmap we are targeting a December 15, 2024 release.

Deliverables:
- Stripe payment gateway integration — Arjun Mehta
- PCI-DSS compliance audit — Kenji Nakamura
- Charge/refund backend API — Riya Desai

Please review ticket NEX-204 (Payments epic). The PCI-DSS requirement is a go-live blocker, so Kenji flag issues early.

Best,
Priya Sharma, Engineering Manager
